sloka: काकुत्स्थं परिपूर्णार्थं दृष्ट्वा सर्वे सुरोत्तमाः ।ऊचुस्ते प्रथमं स्तुत्वा स्तवार्हं सहलक्ष्मणम् ।। ६.१२३.१८ ।।
transliteration: kākutsthaṁ paripūrṇārthaṁ dṛṣṭvā sarve surottamāḥ ।ūcuste prathamaṁ stutvā stavārhaṁ sahalakṣmaṇam ।। 6.123.18 ।।

translations.english: Seeing all of them fully accomplished, the best of Suras very affectionately praised Rama and Lakshmana and spoke.
